About.Head: MORE ABOUT ME ©
About.Text1: I am Ali Ismayil — an IT Project Manager and Product Owner who takes digital and software projects from idea to delivery.
About.Text2: For two years I’ve led 35+ projects end-to-end across corporate platforms, healthcare, e-commerce, real estate and service industries — owning planning, requirement definition, coordination and delivery while keeping business goals and execution aligned. I’m the founder of Insyde, an NFC- and QR-powered digital profile platform whose system I designed and built myself. Backed by 3+ years of front-end development and AI-assisted prototyping, I validate feasibility early and speak the engineering team’s language.
